title_zh: 约定统一食物银行的交接联系人

scenario.label_zh: 约定统一食物银行的交接联系人
scenario.goal_zh: 指出重复接货通知的问题，并分工通过一位协调员确认周六交接时间

context_zh: 两个志愿团队为社区食物银行安排周六接货；此处只讨论协调流程。
author: author-phase10-b

sentences.speaker: Faye
sentences.text: Our teams need to cooperate on Saturday. The driver received two different arrival times.

sentences.speaker: Luca
sentences.text: I can coordinate our side. Who is the coordinator for your team?

sentences.speaker: Faye
sentences.text: Nell. She has been very cooperative, but she is getting messages from four different people.

sentences.speaker: Luca
sentences.text: Then let us give her one contact from each team and keep the driver out of the back-and-forth.

sentences.speaker: Faye
sentences.text: I'll ask everyone on our side to send updates through me. You can send yours to me, and I'll confirm the final time with Nell.

sentences.speaker: Luca
sentences.text: Agreed. We won't send the driver another time until Nell confirms it.
